title: Submit driver to the catalog
intro: The parameters below go to a moderator for review. The driver only appears in search once approved; your project does not change.

fields.variantHint: Impedance or version, for example 4 Ω.
fields.sourceHint: Manufacturer datasheet, your own measurement… Cite the revision or date.
fields.email: Email to notify you of the decision
fields.emailHint: Optional. Used only to tell you whether the driver was approved or rejected, then erased.
fields.diameterHint: Commercial size of the loudspeaker, for example 12".
fields.trap: Do not fill in this field

failure.alreadyInCatalog: This driver is already in the catalog (same manufacturer, model and variant). Look it up in search.
failure.alreadyPending: This driver is already under review. There is no need to submit it again.
failure.rateLimited: Too many submissions in a short time. Try again in {{minutes}} min.
failure.rateLimitedUnknown: Too many submissions in a short time. Try again later.
failure.verification: We could not confirm that you are not a robot. Try again.
failure.network: No connection to the server. What you typed was kept; try again.
failure.server: The server could not receive the submission. What you typed was kept; try again.
failure.invalid: The server rejected some fields. Check the notes below.

success.title: Submission received
success.review: Your driver goes through review and only appears in search once approved.
success.emailNotice: We will email you when there is a decision.

discard.title: Discard the submission?
discard.body: You typed data that has not been sent. Closing now discards it.
